source_title: Is GitHub down for you? Here’s what’s going on (Update: Back online)
source_excerpt:

GitHub has confirmed that its services are experiencing degraded performance.
The issues extend to Webhooks, Actions, and Pages.
Update: October 30, 2026 (4:01 PM ET): According to the GitHub status page, the affected services have been restored. Everything should be working fine now.
Original article: October 30, 2026 (2:10 PM ET): If you’re trying to access GitHub today, you may run into a few problems. The online platform for storing, sharing, and collaborating on software projects is having some issues. GitHub has confirmed there is an outage.
According to the status page for GitHub , the team is currently investigating degraded performance. At the moment, Webhooks, Actions, and Pages are the services that are down. It appears everything else is in the green.
According to reports on Downdetector , this is the second time today that GitHub has gone down. The graph shows that reports also came in around 10 AM ET.
We’ll keep an eye on the situation. When the service is back online, we will update this article.
